capabilities.title: Cross-platform desktop password vault with Electron
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Buttercup Desktop: Electron-based GUI for Buttercup vault files
capabilities.reason: Nexus is not a password manager. Buttercup Desktop's core product is outside scope.

capabilities.title: Desktop UX patterns for credential management in Electron/native app
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Buttercup Desktop UX: vault file management, drag-drop, system tray integration
capabilities.reason: The active VAULT provides explicit locked/unlocked state, secure passphrase fields, auto-lock, encrypted import/export, destructive-action confirmations, and full re-keying in the existing Tauri-capable app. System-tray credential management is intentionally not claimed.

capabilities.title: Buttercup vault file format: AES-256-CBC encrypted JSON vault
capabilities.reason: Nexus does not need a standalone vault file format; settings are stored in the app's data layer.

capabilities.title: Entry edit history and undo for credential changes
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Buttercup: entry history with timestamped change log
capabilities.reason: Each sealed record now retains up to twelve encrypted prior revisions and exposes an explicit restore action; mutation receipts record the restore without leaking note content.
